full.description: This image is a diagram illustrating a histological cross-section related to lung tissue or respiratory mucosa. It depicts a central mucous plug containing structural elements like a Curschmann's spiral and Charcot-Leyden crystals. The surrounding epithelium shows typical cellular interactions associated with an inflammatory response, most likely representing the pathological changes seen in bronchial asthma.

blind.description: This is a diagrammatic illustration depicting microscopic structures found within mucus, specifically associated with bronchial asthma. The image displays the classic appearances of a Curschmann's spiral and Charcot-Leyden crystals. These findings are characteristic of allergic airway inflammation and mucus plugging seen in asthmatic patients. The visual serves as an educational reference for identifying these specific cellular and extracellular components in clinical specimens.
